$comment: Coordinator operations (POST /api/ops/<name>), called by the app and, as MCP tools, by agents. operations lists every registered operation: read (a read snapshot), long (no surrounding transaction), errors (status codes the handler itself returns; every operation can also return 401 signed out, 403 role or grant, and 500). Each operation <name> has $defs <Name>Request and <Name>Reply. A failed call answers OpError. go/coordinator checks at test time that operations equals its registry.

ArtifactListReply.$comment: nextBefore: only with limit; null on the last page.

Block.$comment: One thread entry (docs/designs/fleet-conversations.md), told apart by kind. key is its position seq:part. Fleet's own projection: closed.

BoundaryBlock.$comment: Start of an execution in the thread.

Change.$comment: One committed change (the change table), as GET /api/stream and changes_since deliver it.

ChangeKind.$comment: The kinds the change triggers write (fleet_change and fleet_artifact_change in go/coordinator/schema.sql); a go test checks the triggers against this list.

ChangesSinceReply.$comment: resync: the cursor fell out of retention, reload everything. held: a writer still holds older changes; read again.

ChangesSinceRequest.$comment: No cursor: the head, with no changes. limit is clamped to 1..1000 (default 500).

ListFilter.$comment: The list filter of packages/view-url toPageParams; a null projectId is work outside projects.

ListMembershipRequest.$comment: At most 1000 ids and one or two lists.

ListRow.$comment: A task or session row of a list page; sortKey positions it (strings and numbers).

MeReply.$comment: email, name and grantsVersion are null without a person (agent-only stand).

MembershipAnswer.$comment: rows: the ids that are members of the list now.

OpError.$comment: Body of every failed operation (writeError in go/coordinator/main.go).

QuestionBlock.$comment: options: the stored options as they are (a list of labels for agent questions).

ResultBlock.$comment: The stored artifacts of an ended execution.

SessionCreateReply.$comment: The new session row, plus sessionId.

SessionsListReply.$comment: nextAfter: null on the last page, else the sort key to pass as after.

SessionsListRequest.$comment: after: the nextAfter of the previous page.

StreamCursor.$comment: Body of the GET /api/stream events ready (the cursor the stream starts after) and resync (reload everything, then continue after cursor).

TextBlock.$comment: role agent or operator; by: the sender of an operator message; stream open or cut-off while a delta is the newest text; harness, model and effort mark agent text.

ThreadBlocksReply.$comment: removed: block keys that no longer exist.

ThreadBlocksRequest.$comment: rows: changed records; the reply has their current blocks.

ThreadEntriesReply.$comment: total: only with around. feedCursor: the change cursor of this read, to catch up from.

ThreadKey.$comment: Exactly one of task or session.

ToolBlock.$comment: input and output are the harness's own values; times in ms.
